title: The generator problem for finite factors

result.label: The generator problem for finite factors
result.statement: Proves that every type II 1 factor with separable predual is generated by a single operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators, resolving the generator problem. More strongly, for every irreducible inclusion P M of such factors, the unitaries u with M=W^(P,u) form a dense G δ subset in the trace 2-norm topology.
